item.description:

item.title: FDA Pregnancy Safety Studies
item.description:
• Summary: The FDA issued final guidance on post-approval safety studies for drugs used during pregnancy. The guidance outlines requirements for monitoring long-term safety and efficacy in pregnant populations, impacting drug developers and regulatory submissions.
